How It Works

How to Sell Your Gold in 3 Easy Steps

A simple, transparent and secure process to get a fair value for your gold, silver or diamonds — usually completed in a single visit to our South Extension branch.

1

Visit Our Branch

Bring your gold, silver or diamond items and one valid photo ID to our South Extension branch — 1515, Upper Ground Floor, Wazir Nagar, South Extension Part I, Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi 110003. No appointment needed.

2

Get Your Gold Evaluated

We test purity on the German Karat Meter in front of you, weigh the item at the counter, and give you a fair, transparent price at the day's market rate — the full calculation explained.

3

Receive Instant Payment

Accept our offer and get paid in the same visit via cash, cheque or bank transfer, with a proper receipt. If you don't accept, you take your items back — free, no obligation.

What to Bring

Your items, and one valid government photo ID — Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving License or Passport. PAN is required for transactions of ₹2 lakh and above. A purchase bill is helpful but not compulsory; for pledged gold, bring the loan receipt or pawn ticket as well.

What Happens at the Counter

Your item is tested on the German Karat Meter in front of you — the purity appears on screen and the jewellery is not damaged in any way. It is then weighed at the counter, and the value is calculated as pure-metal weight × the day's market rate, explained line by line. Diamonds set in jewellery are evaluated separately and added. Only when you accept the figure do we complete the documentation and pay you — by cash, cheque or bank transfer, your choice.

No Obligation, Ever

Testing and valuation are free. If the offer doesn't suit you, you take your items back and pay nothing. Many customers get a valuation first, think it over at home, and return when they are ready — that is exactly how the process should work.
